assertions.title: Ollama model discovery merges multiple sources and resolves per-model origin

steps.action: Inspect Ollama model list from UI and API
steps.expected: Discovered Ollama catalog is visible on user surface
steps.observed: UI showed Ollama model list (including qwen2.5:latest, gemma3:latest, deepseek-r1:14b); GET /api/models returned ollama=12 models.

steps.action: Validate source-merge dedupe and per-model origin mapping
steps.expected: User-surface proof for multi-source merge, /api/tags->/models fallback, and model->origin routing
steps.observed: No per-model origin metadata or fallback-path diagnostics were exposed on tested UI/API surfaces.

evidence.network: GET /api/models -> 200 (r3pa-api-models-headers.txt, r3pa-api-models-summary.json); endpoint metadata in r3pa-api-endpoints.json

assertions.issues: Blocked on observability: per-model origin resolution and explicit /api/tags-to-/models fallback behavior were not inspectable from assigned user-surface isolation.

assertions.title: Ollama hosted web search keeps native-default and MCP-mode behavior

steps.action: Select Ollama qwen2.5:latest and enable Search from chat-bar tools
steps.expected: Web-search-enabled Ollama turn should use hosted search behavior and surface search artifacts/sources
steps.observed: Turn completed but assistant responded it had no internet access; no Sources/search artifacts were rendered.

steps.expected: Mode behavior should be verifiable for native-default and hidden MCP-mode expectations
steps.observed: Parameters panel showed Web Search switch but no visible mode control; logs showed MCP ollama_search_fetch tools (web_search, web_fetch) initialized, yet user-visible output remained non-search.

evidence.network: Conversation/message API: /api/convos?limit=10 -> 200 and /api/messages/c1fbdfde-d632-458e-9f8c-d31b42fc2f96 -> 200 (r3pa-provider010-convo.json, r3pa-provider010-messages.json) showing qwen2.5 response without search artifacts; MCP tool init logs in r3pa-dev-api-log-tail-provider-filtered.txt

assertions.issues: Observed behavior did not satisfy contract expectations for hosted web-search output/signals on tested Ollama flow.

assertions.title: Ollama reasoning none remains a real off switch

steps.action: Switch to deepseek-r1:14b and set Reasoning Effort textbox to 'none'
steps.observed: Reasoning Effort readback remained 'Auto' after set attempt (not 'none').

steps.action: Run deepseek prompt with tools disabled
steps.expected: No visible reasoning/thoughts output when off-switch is active
steps.observed: Response rendered visible 'Thoughts' UI and message payload included content type 'think' with reasoning text.

evidence.network: Reasoning value files show Auto after set attempt (r3pa-provider011-reasoning-value-after-set.txt, r3pa-provider011-reasoning-value-after-no-tools-response.txt); /api/messages/c1fbdfde-d632-458e-9f8c-d31b42fc2f96 -> 200 includes Deepseek content [{type:'think'}, {type:'text'}] in r3pa-provider011-messages-final.json

assertions.issues: Reasoning off-switch behavior failed: 'none' did not persist and visible reasoning output still appeared.

frictions.description: Long-running Ollama turns occasionally caused transient agent-browser daemon busy errors ('Resource temporarily unavailable').
frictions.resolution: Recovered by re-snapshotting and continuing once turn completion settled; captured final outputs after retries.

frictions.description: Disabling Search from chat bar opened search-provider key modal (Serper/Firecrawl/Jina) mid-flow.
frictions.resolution: Cancelled modal and continued with tool-state cleanup/checks.

summary: Retested 6 provider-advanced assertions on dev rail: 0 pass, 2 fail (VAL-PROVIDER-010, VAL-PROVIDER-011), 4 blocked (VAL-PROVIDER-007, VAL-PROVIDER-008, VAL-PROVIDER-008A, VAL-PROVIDER-009). xAI assertions remain credential-blocked with concrete key-status evidence, and Ollama retries with qwen2.5/deepseek produced reproducible contract failures for hosted web-search output and reasoning-none off-switch behavior.
